item.title: Surfing in Miyazaki — Guide
item.description: Miyazaki is one of Japan’s premier surfing destinations, blessed with a warm subtropical climate, consistent year-round swells rolling in off the Pacific, and long stretches of sandy beach. The most famous spot is Kisakihama, a long beach south of Miyazaki city that regularly hosts national and international surfing competitions, with reliable, well-shaped waves that draw serious surfers from across Japan. But Miyazaki’s coast also has plenty of gentler beach breaks perfect for beginners, and a lively local surf culture with surf schools, board rental and laid-back beachside cafés.
